name: Form Row family
source: FormRowInputs, FormRowSelect, FormRowRadio, FormRowCheckbox, FormRowButton, FormRowTitle, FormRowTile
summary: Seven layout wrappers that arrange the real form components above into 1–6 column rows for journey pages. Merged into one entry since they're layout containers, not distinct visual components.

tokenFindings.value: consistent step scale: 91 / 206 / 321 / 436 / 551px per added column

capturedNotes: FormRowInputs shows an error state by default in its 2-column example; FormRowSelect shows no error state at all — inconsistent example coverage, not necessarily a real API gap.
FormRowButton and JourneyFooter both duplicate the full Button component inline.
